svg.title: 33 · FDC / MainProgram/WH_SiteBindings
svg.text: ADDED · Use the selected press, not an OR of both presses.
ADDED · A second CDL start while a part is still handled is an overrun.
ADDED · Selected CDL adapter removal/transfer-start observation, with its source timestamp.
ADDED · Source furnace must match the frozen identity; a start may arrive before the stamp selection pass.
ADDED · Do not replace an unconsumed selected-press edge.
ADDED · Latch only the selected 50 MN press Cycle Start; unrelated press events cannot close this transfer.
